name: Atomic Addons for Elementor – Elementor Widgets, Elementor Templates, Elementor Addons & WooCommerce Extensions
author: Oyorox

sections.description:
Atomic Addons is an Elementor addons plugin for WordPress that brings extra widgets, reusable templates and design extensions into the Elementor editor. Create business websites, portfolios, landing pages and blogs with familiar drag-and-drop controls. When your project needs dynamic content, custom theme layouts or advanced store features, Atomic Addons Pro adds tools for those workflows.

Start with the free WordPress.org plugin for content widgets, creative layouts, navigation tools and useful design extensions. The free package also includes the Template Library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator and optional SVG Support. Enable the modules you need in the plugin settings, then use them while designing your pages.

Atomic Addons Pro is a separate premium upgrade. Pro widgets, the Theme Builder, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions and WooCommerce tools are not included in the free download. The sections below explain what each version offers so you can choose the right tools before installing or upgrading.

Elementor Addons for Your Everyday Design Work

An Elementor widget is an individual content element, such as an accordion, carousel or button. An extension adds behavior or styling to an existing element, section or container. Atomic Addons combines both types of tools with reusable templates, giving you several ways to adapt a layout without recreating every detail manually.

For a service website, use feature boxes, brand logos and clear calls to action to explain your offer. For a portfolio, present selected work through image compositions, sliders and comparison layouts. For a blog or online store, the Pro collection provides dedicated post and product widgets that work with your existing WordPress content.

The editor remains your main workspace. Adjust typography, spacing, colors and responsive settings alongside the rest of your Elementor design. You can start with a small selection of elements and activate additional tools as the project develops.

  • 54 free widgets for content, images, buttons, navigation, forms and reviews.
  • Five free extensions for interactive and visual details.
  • A Template Library for importing editable layouts.
  • Live Copy Paste for reusing Elementor content across pages or sites.
  • Optional Pro widgets for dynamic content, forms, marketing and stores.
  • Widget and extension controls for disabling tools you do not use.

Download Atomic Addons for Free

Free Elementor Widgets Included in the Plugin

The free Elementor addons download includes the 54 widgets below. These are the named widgets in the current WordPress.org free inventory. Premium widgets are described separately so you do not mistake a Pro feature for something included in the free package.

Content Widgets

  • Accordion: Organize questions, service details or supporting information into collapsible panels. Use it when visitors need a concise overview with the option to read more.
  • Animated Link: Give text links a distinct hover treatment while keeping them part of your page typography. Use descriptive link text so visitors know where each link leads.
  • Brand Carousel: Present client, partner or brand logos in a sliding layout. This is useful when a static row would take up too much horizontal space.
  • Brand Grid: Arrange logos in a structured grid for an easy-to-scan partner or client section. Choose this format when every logo should remain visible together.
  • Call Out: Draw attention to an announcement, offer or next step with a dedicated content box and call to action.
  • Fancy List: Present benefits, services or checklist items with custom visual styling. Keep each item focused on one useful point.
  • Featured Box: Combine a heading, description, icon and link to introduce a feature or service. Repeat the layout to create a consistent overview section.
  • Image Stack: Arrange overlapping images for a layered composition. This can help present a collection of screens, project previews or supporting photographs.
  • Static Carousel: Display a set of manually prepared slides in a carousel. Choose this when you want direct control over each slide rather than a feed of posts.
  • Logo Carousel: Showcase logos in a sliding presentation.
  • Logo Grid: Display company logos in a structured grid.
  • Business Hours: Present opening hours in a clear schedule.
  • Barcode: Display barcodes within your page layout.
  • Changelog: Organize product updates and release notes.
  • Document Viewer: Display documents within your page.
  • Member: Introduce team members with profile cards.
  • Price Grid: Arrange manually prepared product cards in a grid.
  • Price Carousel: Present manually prepared product or pricing cards in a carousel.
  • Progress Pie: Show progress using circular visual indicators.
  • Search: Place a search interface in your layout.
  • Static Grid Tab: Organize manually selected content in tabbed grids.
  • Step Flow: Explain a process through a sequence of steps.

Creative and Media Widgets

  • Creative Button: Style a call-to-action button with visual effects and icon options. Match the button treatment to the importance of the action.
  • Dual Button: Place two related actions together, such as viewing a demo and reading more information, without designing separate button layouts.
  • Slider: Present slides with supporting captions and buttons. Keep essential information easy to access instead of relying on visitors to see every slide.
  • Hover Box: Reveal supporting text or links through an interactive box. Review the experience on touch devices as well as desktop screens.
  • Hover Video: Use a video preview in a portfolio or product presentation. Choose concise media and check its effect on page loading.
  • Image Accordion: Turn a group of images into expanding panels. Use it to introduce a small collection of categories, destinations or projects.
  • Image Compare: Place two images in a before-and-after comparison with a draggable divider. Use comparable images so the difference is easy to understand.
  • Image Expand: Create an expanding image presentation.
  • Interactive Card: Present content in an interactive card layout.
  • Interactive Links: Give navigation links an interactive visual treatment.
  • Flip Box: Display front and back content in flipping cards.
  • Lightbox: Open media in an overlay for closer viewing.
  • Lottie Image: Display Lottie animations within your design.
  • Marker: Highlight points of interest on an image.
  • Audio Player: Add audio playback to your Elementor pages.

Menu and Navigation Widgets

  • Mobile Menu: Add a mobile navigation layout with a menu toggle. Check labels, spacing and tap targets as part of your responsive review.
  • Scrollnav: Connect a one-page menu to sections on the same page. This suits service pages and portfolios with clearly defined content areas.
  • Navbar: Add a navigation bar to your page.
  • Dropbar: Reveal additional content in a dropdown panel.
  • Vertical Menu: Arrange navigation links in a vertical list.
  • Scroll Button: Add a button for page scrolling.

Form and User Widgets

  • Forminator Forms: Display and style forms created with Forminator inside Elementor. The Forminator plugin is needed for the underlying form functionality.
  • Contact Form 7: Style forms from the Contact Form 7 plugin.
  • WPForms: Display and style forms created with WPForms.
  • Ninja Forms: Style forms created with Ninja Forms.
  • Everest Forms: Display and style existing Everest Forms.
  • User Register: Provide a registration form for new users.

Marketing and Social Widgets

  • Review Card Carousel: Display review cards in a carousel.
  • Review Card Grid: Arrange review cards in a grid.
  • Social Share: Add sharing options for your content.
  • Total Count: Highlight totals with a count display.

Special Widgets

  • Age Gate: Display an age-confirmation prompt before selected content. An age prompt is not a substitute for any verification process your business may require.

Five Free Elementor Extensions

Extensions help you add detail to an existing layout instead of introducing another standalone widget. The free package includes these five options for supported Elementor elements and layout containers.

  • Backdrop Filter: Apply visual treatments such as blur and brightness to the area behind an element. Review text contrast when using translucent surfaces.
  • Grid Line: Add decorative grid lines to complement a structured page design. Use them selectively so they support the content rather than compete with it.
  • Ripple Effects: Add a ripple interaction to selected elements. A small response can help make an interaction feel more noticeable.
  • Tooltip: Provide short supporting information through a tooltip. Keep essential instructions visible in the main page content rather than hiding them only in tooltips.
  • Wrapper Link: Make a supported container or section clickable. Use it for a clearly defined destination and avoid confusing combinations of overlapping links.

Reusable Templates and Free Workflow Tools

Elementor Template Library

The Template Library gives you a starting point for page and section layouts. Import an available template, replace the sample content and adjust its appearance in Elementor. You can change text, images, colors, spacing and other editable settings to match the website you are creating.

Templates are starting layouts, not finished websites. Review each imported section for your own content, branding and responsive needs. Check whether a selected template uses premium widgets before relying on it in a free-only project. Template and widget availability should match the version you have installed.

Live Copy Paste

Reuse Elementor content across pages or supported sites with Live Copy Paste. Copy an existing design and place it where you need the same structure, rather than manually rebuilding its layout and styling. Enable the feature in settings before using the workflow.

Cross-site reuse is particularly helpful for repeated sections such as service summaries and calls to action. After pasting, review destination-specific text, links and images. Also check that the destination has the widgets and dependencies used by the original design.

Duplicator and SVG Support

Duplicator supports a repeatable workflow for posts, pages and templates. Use a duplicate as the starting point for a related page, then replace the content that should be unique. Before publication, check titles, links and any copied information that belongs to the original page.

Optional SVG Support allows SVG handling within the plugin’s supported workflow. SVG files are useful for scalable graphics such as icons and logos. Only upload files from sources you trust and review your site’s upload permissions before enabling additional file types.

Atomic Addons Pro: More Control for Complex Projects

The premium version expands the collection with 108 Pro Elementor widgets, 17 Pro design extensions and site-building features. Choose Pro when your project needs functionality beyond the free tools, such as dynamic post layouts, a visual theme builder or dedicated WooCommerce page elements.

You do not need to activate every premium feature at once. Select the modules relevant to the website, configure them and test the resulting pages. This keeps the editing workspace focused and makes it easier to understand which features a project actually depends on.

Advanced Content and Creative Widgets

Pro content widgets include Advanced Heading, Advanced Icon Box, Advanced Counter, Advanced Progress Bar, Circle Info, Comparison List, Content Switcher, Interactive Tabs, Modal, Price List and Reading Progress. These tools support different content tasks, from explaining opening hours to organizing detailed information into tabs.

Pro creative options include Advanced Image Gallery, Animated Heading, Creative Gallery, Marquee, Stacker, SVG Blob and Video Gallery. Use them where a visual treatment helps explain or present the content. Motion and effects should complement a clear page structure, not become the only way visitors can access important information.

Navigation and Mega Menu Builder

Atomic Addons Pro includes navigation widgets such as Mega Menu, Sub Menu, Circle Menu, Off-Canvas and Table of Content. Create navigation that reflects how your website is organized, from a simple list of pages to a larger dropdown with multiple content areas.

The Elementor mega menu builder supports visual dropdown layouts. Use it to group related destinations and make a larger website easier to browse. After designing the desktop menu, review its mobile behavior and make sure important destinations remain easy to find.

Post Widgets and Dynamic Content

Present WordPress content through Post Grid, Post Carousel, Post List, Post Slider, timelines and other dynamic layouts. Instead of maintaining a separate manual card for every article, use post-based widgets to display content from your website.

Single-post elements include Post Title, Post Content, Post Featured Image, Post Info and Post Comments. Dynamic Grid, Dynamic Carousel, Dynamic Accordion and Dynamic Tabs offer additional ways to organize entries. Choose a layout based on how visitors need to browse the content, not simply the number of visual effects available.

Dynamic Tags and Display Conditions

Dynamic Tags connect supported widget settings to data such as post information, WooCommerce content, user details and Advanced Custom Fields. This lets a reusable design display the relevant information for each entry instead of repeating fixed text everywhere.

Display Conditions control whether supported content appears under configured rules. They help adapt a page to different contexts without maintaining separate copies of the same layout. Test every important rule, including the fallback state, before using conditional content on a live website.

Forms, User and Marketing Widgets

Pro includes Contact Form, Webhook Form, Mailchimp and User Login widgets. User Register and the style widgets for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Everest Forms and Forminator are included free. Integration widgets style or display content from the relevant service or plugin; they do not replace every feature of that separate product.

Pro marketing options include Price Table, Countdown, Google Reviews, Social Proof and Facebook, Instagram and Twitter feeds. Social Share and the review-card layouts are included free. Choose tools that support an honest offer and a clear next step. Where an integration uses an external service, review its account requirements and configuration before adding it to a page.

Elementor Theme Builder and Header Footer Design

Atomic Addons Pro provides a visual Theme Builder for custom headers, footers, single-post layouts and WooCommerce single-product templates. Design these areas in Elementor rather than editing theme files for each visual adjustment.

A reusable header can combine navigation, search and relevant actions in one consistent layout. A footer can bring together useful links, business information and supporting content. Post and product templates provide a shared structure while displaying the information associated with the current entry.

Review template assignments carefully. A design intended for one content type should not accidentally replace unrelated pages. Preview representative posts or products, including entries with unusually long titles or missing optional images, before applying a template more widely.

Seventeen Pro Design Extensions

Pro extensions add further control over motion, positioning and visual styling. They include AdBlock Detector, Animated Gradient Background, Confetti Effects, Cursor Effects, Custom CSS / JS, Equal Height, Floating Effects, Global Badge, Liquid Glass Effects, Notation, Parallax Effects, Particles, Reveal Effects, Scroll Box, Sticky, Text Gradient Background and Transform Effects.

Use Equal Height for consistent card layouts, Sticky for supported elements that need to remain in view, and Notation to emphasize selected text. Liquid Glass Effects and gradient treatments add surface styling, while floating, parallax and reveal effects add movement.

sections.installation:
Install Through WordPress

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and active on your WordPress website.
  2. Open Plugins > Add New in the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Search for Atomic Addons for Elementor and select the correct plugin.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Open the Atomic Addons settings and enable the available modules you need.
  6. Edit a page with Elementor and find the enabled Atomic Addons widgets in the editor panel.
  7. Add a widget, configure its content and review the layout on different screen sizes.
  8. Save or publish the page after checking the result.

Installation activates the free package. Pro widgets and premium extensions require the separate Atomic Addons Pro upgrade. WooCommerce-specific tools also require WooCommerce to be active.

Manual Installation

Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org. In your dashboard, open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, select the ZIP and install it. Activate the plugin after installation and confirm Elementor is active. If uploading extracted files through your hosting tools, the plugin directory remains named atomic-elements; that technical folder name is not the public product name.

Requirements and Update Checks

The listing specifies WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 7.4 or later and Elementor. WooCommerce is required only for WooCommerce-specific features. Check the current plugin requirements before installation because supported versions can change as the software develops. Use a supported server environment and keep backups before major updates.
sections.faq:
What are Elementor addons?

Elementor addons are plugins that extend the Elementor page builder with extra widgets, templates or features. Atomic Addons adds content and design tools to Elementor, with optional premium features for dynamic websites, theme layouts and WooCommerce stores. It works alongside Elementor rather than replacing it.

Is Atomic Addons free to use?

Yes. The WordPress.org version is free and includes 54 widgets, five extensions and workflow modules such as the Template Library and Live Copy Paste. Atomic Addons Pro is an optional paid upgrade for additional widgets and premium functionality.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

You can use the free Atomic Addons plugin with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required for that free package. Atomic Addons Pro is a separate product, so do not confuse its premium license with an Elementor Pro subscription.

What is the difference between Atomic Addons Free and Pro?

Free provides the core widget collection, free extensions and supported workflow tools. Pro adds advanced content, navigation, marketing and form widgets, plus Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, Theme Builder functionality and WooCommerce tools. Check the feature’s Free or Pro label before planning a layout around it.

How do I add Atomic Addons widgets to Elementor?

Install and activate Atomic Addons, confirm Elementor is active and enable the desired widgets in the plugin settings. Open a page in Elementor, find the available widget in the editor panel and drag it into your layout. Premium widgets require the Pro version.

Does Atomic Addons work with every WordPress theme?

Atomic Addons is designed for Elementor-based websites and is intended to work with themes that support Elementor. Compatibility with every possible theme configuration cannot be guaranteed. Test your theme, template assignments and other plugins together on a staging site before making major live changes.

Can I use Atomic Addons with other Elementor addons?

You can use multiple addon plugins when your project needs features from different tools. Avoid unnecessary overlap and test the combination before publishing. If a conflict appears, reproduce it on staging and identify the specific widget, extension or setting involved before contacting support.

Will Atomic Addons slow down my website?

The plugin provides conditional asset loading and controls for disabling unused features. Actual performance depends on the complete website, including media, hosting, theme and other plugins. Measure representative pages before and after significant changes rather than assuming any addon has no performance impact.

Does Atomic Addons include Elementor templates?

Yes. The Template Library offers importable layouts that you can edit in Elementor. Enable the module, choose an available template and replace its sample content. Check whether the selected design uses premium widgets or other dependencies before using it on a free-only website.

Can I copy Elementor sections to another website?

Live Copy Paste supports reusing Elementor content across pages or supported sites when the feature is enabled. Review the copied section on the destination website and confirm that required widgets are available. Update any text, media or links that should differ from the original.

Can I create custom headers and footers?

Yes. Atomic Addons Pro includes header, footer and theme-building functionality. Design the layout visually and configure where it appears. Check mobile navigation and template assignments before applying a new header or footer throughout the website.

Does Atomic Addons support dynamic content and ACF?

Pro includes Dynamic Tags for supported content sources, including Advanced Custom Fields. Use them to connect compatible design settings to stored data. You need the relevant content, custom fields and dependencies configured before a dynamic layout can display the expected information.

Can I customize WooCommerce pages with Elementor?

Atomic Addons Pro provides WooCommerce widgets for products, catalogs, cart, checkout and account-related layouts. WooCommerce must be installed and active. Test the completed store with your payment methods and other extensions before publishing changes to purchase-related pages.

Are the WooCommerce extensions included in the free plugin?

No. The WooCommerce extensions described here require Atomic Addons Pro. They include Variation Swatches, Quick View, Wishlist, Compare and other store tools. Installing the free WordPress.org package alone does not unlock those premium extensions.

Do form integration widgets replace form plugins?

No. Widgets for tools such as Forminator, WPForms and Contact Form 7 work with those plugins. Install and configure the relevant form plugin first, then use its compatible Atomic Addons widget to display or style the form in Elementor.

Can beginners use Atomic Addons without coding?

Most visual widget configuration happens through Elementor controls, making the plugin suitable for users who prefer a visual editor. More advanced tasks, such as custom JavaScript, webhooks or complex store rules, may require additional technical knowledge and testing.

Where can I find documentation or get support?

Use the official Atomic Addons documentation for setup guidance and feature instructions. For the free WordPress.org plugin, use its support forum. Include your plugin versions, a clear description and reproduction steps, but never post passwords, payment information or other private credentials publicly.

How do I keep Atomic Addons updated?

Check the Plugins or Updates area in your WordPress dashboard for available updates to the free plugin. Review release notes and keep a backup before updating. For Pro, follow the account and update instructions supplied with your premium license, and test important workflows after changes.

description:
Atomic Addons is an Elementor addons plugin for WordPress that brings extra widgets, reusable templates and design extensions into the Elementor editor. Create business websites, portfolios, landing pages and blogs with familiar drag-and-drop controls. When your project needs dynamic content, custom theme layouts or advanced store features, Atomic Addons Pro adds tools for those workflows.

Start with the free WordPress.org plugin for content widgets, creative layouts, navigation tools and useful design extensions. The free package also includes the Template Library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator and optional SVG Support. Enable the modules you need in the plugin settings, then use them while designing your pages.

Atomic Addons Pro is a separate premium upgrade. Pro widgets, the Theme Builder, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions and WooCommerce tools are not included in the free download. The sections below explain what each version offers so you can choose the right tools before installing or upgrading.

Elementor Addons for Your Everyday Design Work

An Elementor widget is an individual content element, such as an accordion, carousel or button. An extension adds behavior or styling to an existing element, section or container. Atomic Addons combines both types of tools with reusable templates, giving you several ways to adapt a layout without recreating every detail manually.

For a service website, use feature boxes, brand logos and clear calls to action to explain your offer. For a portfolio, present selected work through image compositions, sliders and comparison layouts. For a blog or online store, the Pro collection provides dedicated post and product widgets that work with your existing WordPress content.

The editor remains your main workspace. Adjust typography, spacing, colors and responsive settings alongside the rest of your Elementor design. You can start with a small selection of elements and activate additional tools as the project develops.

  • 54 free widgets for content, images, buttons, navigation, forms and reviews.
  • Five free extensions for interactive and visual details.
  • A Template Library for importing editable layouts.
  • Live Copy Paste for reusing Elementor content across pages or sites.
  • Optional Pro widgets for dynamic content, forms, marketing and stores.
  • Widget and extension controls for disabling tools you do not use.

Download Atomic Addons for Free

Free Elementor Widgets Included in the Plugin

The free Elementor addons download includes the 54 widgets below. These are the named widgets in the current WordPress.org free inventory. Premium widgets are described separately so you do not mistake a Pro feature for something included in the free package.

Content Widgets

  • Accordion: Organize questions, service details or supporting information into collapsible panels. Use it when visitors need a concise overview with the option to read more.
  • Animated Link: Give text links a distinct hover treatment while keeping them part of your page typography. Use descriptive link text so visitors know where each link leads.
  • Brand Carousel: Present client, partner or brand logos in a sliding layout. This is useful when a static row would take up too much horizontal space.
  • Brand Grid: Arrange logos in a structured grid for an easy-to-scan partner or client section. Choose this format when every logo should remain visible together.
  • Call Out: Draw attention to an announcement, offer or next step with a dedicated content box and call to action.
  • Fancy List: Present benefits, services or checklist items with custom visual styling. Keep each item focused on one useful point.
  • Featured Box: Combine a heading, description, icon and link to introduce a feature or service. Repeat the layout to create a consistent overview section.
  • Image Stack: Arrange overlapping images for a layered composition. This can help present a collection of screens, project previews or supporting photographs.
  • Static Carousel: Display a set of manually prepared slides in a carousel. Choose this when you want direct control over each slide rather than a feed of posts.
  • Logo Carousel: Showcase logos in a sliding presentation.
  • Logo Grid: Display company logos in a structured grid.
  • Business Hours: Present opening hours in a clear schedule.
  • Barcode: Display barcodes within your page layout.
  • Changelog: Organize product updates and release notes.
  • Document Viewer: Display documents within your page.
  • Member: Introduce team members with profile cards.
  • Price Grid: Arrange manually prepared product cards in a grid.
  • Price Carousel: Present manually prepared product or pricing cards in a carousel.
  • Progress Pie: Show progress using circular visual indicators.
  • Search: Place a search interface in your layout.
  • Static Grid Tab: Organize manually selected content in tabbed grids.
  • Step Flow: Explain a process through a sequence of steps.

Creative and Media Widgets

  • Creative Button: Style a call-to-action button with visual effects and icon options. Match the button treatment to the importance of the action.
  • Dual Button: Place two related actions together, such as viewing a demo and reading more information, without designing separate button layouts.
  • Slider: Present slides with supporting captions and buttons. Keep essential information easy to access instead of relying on visitors to see every slide.
  • Hover Box: Reveal supporting text or links through an interactive box. Review the experience on touch devices as well as desktop screens.
  • Hover Video: Use a video preview in a portfolio or product presentation. Choose concise media and check its effect on page loading.
  • Image Accordion: Turn a group of images into expanding panels. Use it to introduce a small collection of categories, destinations or projects.
  • Image Compare: Place two images in a before-and-after comparison with a draggable divider. Use comparable images so the difference is easy to understand.
  • Image Expand: Create an expanding image presentation.
  • Interactive Card: Present content in an interactive card layout.
  • Interactive Links: Give navigation links an interactive visual treatment.
  • Flip Box: Display front and back content in flipping cards.
  • Lightbox: Open media in an overlay for closer viewing.
  • Lottie Image: Display Lottie animations within your design.
  • Marker: Highlight points of interest on an image.
  • Audio Player: Add audio playback to your Elementor pages.

Menu and Navigation Widgets

  • Mobile Menu: Add a mobile navigation layout with a menu toggle. Check labels, spacing and tap targets as part of your responsive review.
  • Scrollnav: Connect a one-page menu to sections on the same page. This suits service pages and portfolios with clearly defined content areas.
  • Navbar: Add a navigation bar to your page.
  • Dropbar: Reveal additional content in a dropdown panel.
  • Vertical Menu: Arrange navigation links in a vertical list.
  • Scroll Button: Add a button for page scrolling.

Form and User Widgets

  • Forminator Forms: Display and style forms created with Forminator inside Elementor. The Forminator plugin is needed for the underlying form functionality.
  • Contact Form 7: Style forms from the Contact Form 7 plugin.
  • WPForms: Display and style forms created with WPForms.
  • Ninja Forms: Style forms created with Ninja Forms.
  • Everest Forms: Display and style existing Everest Forms.
  • User Register: Provide a registration form for new users.

Marketing and Social Widgets

  • Review Card Carousel: Display review cards in a carousel.
  • Review Card Grid: Arrange review cards in a grid.
  • Social Share: Add sharing options for your content.
  • Total Count: Highlight totals with a count display.

Special Widgets

  • Age Gate: Display an age-confirmation prompt before selected content. An age prompt is not a substitute for any verification process your business may require.

Five Free Elementor Extensions

Extensions help you add detail to an existing layout instead of introducing another standalone widget. The free package includes these five options for supported Elementor elements and layout containers.

  • Backdrop Filter: Apply visual treatments such as blur and brightness to the area behind an element. Review text contrast when using translucent surfaces.
  • Grid Line: Add decorative grid lines to complement a structured page design. Use them selectively so they support the content rather than compete with it.
  • Ripple Effects: Add a ripple interaction to selected elements. A small response can help make an interaction feel more noticeable.
  • Tooltip: Provide short supporting information through a tooltip. Keep essential instructions visible in the main page content rather than hiding them only in tooltips.
  • Wrapper Link: Make a supported container or section clickable. Use it for a clearly defined destination and avoid confusing combinations of overlapping links.

Reusable Templates and Free Workflow Tools

Elementor Template Library

The Template Library gives you a starting point for page and section layouts. Import an available template, replace the sample content and adjust its appearance in Elementor. You can change text, images, colors, spacing and other editable settings to match the website you are creating.

Templates are starting layouts, not finished websites. Review each imported section for your own content, branding and responsive needs. Check whether a selected template uses premium widgets before relying on it in a free-only project. Template and widget availability should match the version you have installed.

Live Copy Paste

Reuse Elementor content across pages or supported sites with Live Copy Paste. Copy an existing design and place it where you need the same structure, rather than manually rebuilding its layout and styling. Enable the feature in settings before using the workflow.

Cross-site reuse is particularly helpful for repeated sections such as service summaries and calls to action. After pasting, review destination-specific text, links and images. Also check that the destination has the widgets and dependencies used by the original design.

Duplicator and SVG Support

Duplicator supports a repeatable workflow for posts, pages and templates. Use a duplicate as the starting point for a related page, then replace the content that should be unique. Before publication, check titles, links and any copied information that belongs to the original page.

Optional SVG Support allows SVG handling within the plugin’s supported workflow. SVG files are useful for scalable graphics such as icons and logos. Only upload files from sources you trust and review your site’s upload permissions before enabling additional file types.

Atomic Addons Pro: More Control for Complex Projects

The premium version expands the collection with 108 Pro Elementor widgets, 17 Pro design extensions and site-building features. Choose Pro when your project needs functionality beyond the free tools, such as dynamic post layouts, a visual theme builder or dedicated WooCommerce page elements.

You do not need to activate every premium feature at once. Select the modules relevant to the website, configure them and test the resulting pages. This keeps the editing workspace focused and makes it easier to understand which features a project actually depends on.

Advanced Content and Creative Widgets

Pro content widgets include Advanced Heading, Advanced Icon Box, Advanced Counter, Advanced Progress Bar, Circle Info, Comparison List, Content Switcher, Interactive Tabs, Modal, Price List and Reading Progress. These tools support different content tasks, from explaining opening hours to organizing detailed information into tabs.

Pro creative options include Advanced Image Gallery, Animated Heading, Creative Gallery, Marquee, Stacker, SVG Blob and Video Gallery. Use them where a visual treatment helps explain or present the content. Motion and effects should complement a clear page structure, not become the only way visitors can access important information.

Navigation and Mega Menu Builder

Atomic Addons Pro includes navigation widgets such as Mega Menu, Sub Menu, Circle Menu, Off-Canvas and Table of Content. Create navigation that reflects how your website is organized, from a simple list of pages to a larger dropdown with multiple content areas.

The Elementor mega menu builder supports visual dropdown layouts. Use it to group related destinations and make a larger website easier to browse. After designing the desktop menu, review its mobile behavior and make sure important destinations remain easy to find.

Post Widgets and Dynamic Content

Present WordPress content through Post Grid, Post Carousel, Post List, Post Slider, timelines and other dynamic layouts. Instead of maintaining a separate manual card for every article, use post-based widgets to display content from your website.

Single-post elements include Post Title, Post Content, Post Featured Image, Post Info and Post Comments. Dynamic Grid, Dynamic Carousel, Dynamic Accordion and Dynamic Tabs offer additional ways to organize entries. Choose a layout based on how visitors need to browse the content, not simply the number of visual effects available.

Dynamic Tags and Display Conditions

Dynamic Tags connect supported widget settings to data such as post information, WooCommerce content, user details and Advanced Custom Fields. This lets a reusable design display the relevant information for each entry instead of repeating fixed text everywhere.

Display Conditions control whether supported content appears under configured rules. They help adapt a page to different contexts without maintaining separate copies of the same layout. Test every important rule, including the fallback state, before using conditional content on a live website.

Forms, User and Marketing Widgets

Pro includes Contact Form, Webhook Form, Mailchimp and User Login widgets. User Register and the style widgets for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Everest Forms and Forminator are included free. Integration widgets style or display content from the relevant service or plugin; they do not replace every feature of that separate product.

Pro marketing options include Price Table, Countdown, Google Reviews, Social Proof and Facebook, Instagram and Twitter feeds. Social Share and the review-card layouts are included free. Choose tools that support an honest offer and a clear next step. Where an integration uses an external service, review its account requirements and configuration before adding it to a page.

Elementor Theme Builder and Header Footer Design

Atomic Addons Pro provides a visual Theme Builder for custom headers, footers, single-post layouts and WooCommerce single-product templates. Design these areas in Elementor rather than editing theme files for each visual adjustment.

A reusable header can combine navigation, search and relevant actions in one consistent layout. A footer can bring together useful links, business information and supporting content. Post and product templates provide a shared structure while displaying the information associated with the current entry.

Review template assignments carefully. A design intended for one content type should not accidentally replace unrelated pages. Preview representative posts or products, including entries with unusually long titles or missing optional images, before applying a template more widely.

Seventeen Pro Design Extensions

Pro extensions add further control over motion, positioning and visual styling. They include AdBlock Detector, Animated Gradient Background, Confetti Effects, Cursor Effects, Custom CSS / JS, Equal Height, Floating Effects, Global Badge, Liquid Glass Effects, Notation, Parallax Effects, Particles, Reveal Effects, Scroll Box, Sticky, Text Gradient Background and Transform Effects.

Use Equal Height for consistent card layouts, Sticky for supported elements that need to remain in view, and Notation to emphasize selected text. Liquid Glass Effects and gradient treatments add surface styling, while floating, parallax and reveal effects add movement.
